name: Unohana Yayoi
source:
A female student at Mutsuki Academy.
She is in the same class as Yuki Samejima and is the committee's chairwoman. She has a cheerful personality and treats everyone without distinction, but she is also easily swayed. She's the chairwoman not because she wants to be, but because she was forced to be.

She saw Yuki getting involved with a creature, and asked her if she could be a partner for the "special pet" as well.

[translated from [url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/cyclet_pro/aigan/character.html]official website[/url]]
